dedupe_keys.name: inishmore estimated building properties and simulation results

description: Niall Buckley at Integrated Environmental Solutions publishes estimated building properties and energy-consumption simulation results covering Inishmore in Ireland’s Aran Islands. The February 2025 deposit supplies one GeoJSON file freely under CC BY 4.0. Property assumptions come from external visual inspections of multiple buildings. The provider explicitly states that local Energy Performance Certificates have not validated these estimates. They can supply starting assumptions for community energy simulations, subject to local checks and uncertainty analysis. The public metadata leave building counts, inspection dates, demand units and the simulation engine unknown. Related catalogue record platform-ies-virtual-environment identifies IES software but does not establish which engine produced these values. The first-review Inishmore microgrid narrative does not explicitly include this separate public dataset. The GeoJSON was not downloaded or compared with surveyed building characteristics.
